name: Waveform 91
tagline: The open-air grid for Bengaluru's independent voices
prompt: A scheduling board for a community radio station in Bengaluru: shows, volunteer hosts and the weekly on-air grid

spec.name: Waveform 91
spec.world: Bengaluru's independent radio collective broadcasting live from Indiranagar. Key hosts include DJ Sandeep (of 'Electronic City Soul'), Malini K. ('Indiranagar Echoes'), and Priya Nair. The current studio rental rate is ₹450 per hour for commercial slots, but volunteer shows are free. The calendar revolves around the upcoming Weekend Takeover on Saturday, 18 October, and Sunday, 19 October, which features 36 continuous hours of live local broadcasts.

imagery.subject: A vibrant, high-contrast close-up of a broadcast mixing desk in Indiranagar with glowing yellow dials and colorful cables
An independent radio host wearing chunky headphones smiling behind an old-school professional microphone
A busy whiteboard in a Bengaluru community center covered with colorful sticky notes showing radio show ideas and host names
A glowing neon 'ON AIR' sign reflecting off a glass window pane looking into a cozy studio filled with records

spec.summary: A collaborative scheduling dashboard for community radio hosts, engineers, and volunteers to claim slots, manage show archives, and coordinate the live studio feed in real-time.

directions.why: Provides absolute clarity, structured order, and maximum usability for highly dense and complex broadcast calendars.
directions.name: Kranz Grid
directions.pitch: A rigorous, information-first scheduling construct that handles live broadcast density with total functional clarity, heavy rules, and striking signal red.
directions.twist: Strict 12-column grid layout with zero borders, using monochromatic gray shades with a single accent color of emergency orange, styled with high-density system-font lists and strict layout rules.
directions.motion: Mechanical grid shifts with 150ms instant slide transitions. No springs or decorative bounces.
directions.imagery: High-contrast, stark black-and-white portraits of DJs and hosts, brutally cropped at exact vertical and horizontal layout axes, with zero atmospheric soft glow.
signature: Gigantic right-aligned live broadcast times cutting off right at the container edge
Complete omission of rounded corners on all UI surfaces and elements
A single, unmistakable signal-red block representing the current live on-air program
